crime_description: Stealing the legendary Excalibur replica from the National Museum. Interrogators should probe for connections to an inside accomplice, a hidden agenda, remote burner phone coordination, offshore accounts, and private flight plans.

suspect.name: Morgan LeFay
suspect.fake_alibi: Morgan claims she was participating in a historical reenactment battle in a nearby park.

secrets.value: The night watchman, Arthur, who was charmed into opening the display case.
Morgan is obsessed with Arthurian legend and believes the sword grants her mystical powers.

untraceable offshore account holding the illicit funds
